scoring_justification: Checker evaluates agent's polynomial at hidden temperatures against paper's Table 2 Cp/R values (recompute from artifact), and compares 298.15 thermodynamic functions to paper's reported gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Cp/R values at selected temperatures (15, 30, 100, 200, 300 K) from the paper's Table 2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (Standard molar thermodynamic properties of silicalite SiO2)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly read from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published values; they are the ground truth for this reproduction task.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference dimensionless thermodynamic functions at 298.15 K (Cp/R, DeltaS/R, DeltaH/(R·K)).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and abstract: Cp,m°(298.15 K)=46.34 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹, DeltaS=46.29, DeltaH=888.1 J·mol⁻¹; converted to dimensionless using R=8.3144 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Numbers derived from the paper's explicitly stated values and gas constant.

required.low_T_poly: array of floats (coefficients ascending order for T < 40 K)
required.high_T_poly: array of floats (coefficients ascending order for T > 20 K)

outputs.description: Polynomial coefficients obtained from weighted least-squares fitting of experimental heat capacity data. The checker evaluates these polynomials at hidden temperatures and compares the resulting Cp/R to the paper's reference values with tolerance.

Standard molar heat capacity, entropy change, and enthalpy increment at 298.15 K derived by integration of the fitted polynomials and Debye extrapolation. Compared to paper-reported values with relative tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the fitting from the same raw data and integrates to obtain reference values. The agent's artifacts are compared to these reference values within tolerances. The high-temperature enthalpy, combustion, and reaction calorimetry sections are excluded from this reproduction scope.
